---
name: Research question
about: Something we are about to build rests on an assumption nobody has checked
title: ''
labels: research
assignees: ''
---

**The assumption** — what are we about to take for granted?

**Why it matters** — what gets built wrong, or what number becomes indefensible, if it is false?

**What would settle it** — a paper, a dataset, a measurement we could run, an API request we
have not issued. Be specific; "we ruled out a data source on documentation instead of on a
request" is a mistake this project has already made once and written down.

**What has already been looked at** — sources checked, and what they did and did not say.

**Blocking?** — is someone waiting on this, or can it run alongside?
